objective: Implement the person normalization layer so repeated contacts can be stored consistently, suggested by name or phone, and linked to projects with explicit relationship types.
success_criteria: A local person normalization service exists for create, update, lookup, and project linking flows.
Person lookup supports suggestions by normalized name and normalized phone digits.
People can be linked to projects using explicit relation types.
The implementation remains local-only and uses the existing schema support for people and project_people.
stop_conditions: The task requires schema changes outside the current migration set.
The task requires UI shell or route wiring.
The task requires remote contact sync or external identity services.
approval_gates: Changing schema instead of implementing on the existing people tables
notes: Use the existing people and project_people tables and relation enum.
Keep this at the application-flow level so future project forms can reuse it directly.
